newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates end little changed.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed around opening levels on Friday, the last session in the current reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 21.25 percent, after opening at 21.25/50, and compared to Thursday's close of 21.375 percent.
Overnight rates hovered in a narrow range of 21.25 to 21.50 percent in routine trade. The last day of banks' reserve period usually brings sharp rate falls, but Friday was an exception.
"There were not any dramatic developments, there were not any signs of dramas," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
